card.name: Spacing before numbers of years
card.fires_on: The space or small word just before a number in news-style web text, especially a span of years or a count, as in "comes 25 years after" or "over 39 million".

modes.label: Before a year count
modes.description: The gap or word right before a number of years, such as 'comes', 'past' or 'mark the'.

modes.label: Before a population figure
modes.description: The word or space before a large number in a statistic.

card.plain: It fires just before a number is about to appear, mostly a number of years or a statistic in news text.
